reviews.text:
Routine. They found a broken tooth and I was advised to have it extracted. We will return next week for that. Glad the tooth was discovered.

Tooth was extracted today and she is recovering nicely. She was clearly in pain as her sedation wore off but the pain meds they prescribed helped.
Wonderful experience from everyone! Great communication from the staff. They treat our dogs like they was their own!

A five-star rating like this is encouraging to see.

It tells us the care felt steady and reassuring, which is exactly what we aim for during every visit. Julie’s satisfaction means a great deal to the team, and we appreciate the confidence shown in Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas.

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We're delighted to know that you're happy with our care and support. Our team is dedicated to offering the best service for you and your pet. We appreciate your trust in us and look forward to seeing you again!

A 5-star rating like this is genuinely encouraging.

It’s good to know the experience at Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas felt right from your side. The team works hard to keep visits calm, capable, and thoughtful, and your support shows that effort is being felt.
Thank you all for being such a pro & nice, friendly and courageous.

A 5-star rating is always encouraging to see, and it reflects the kind of visit we aim to provide at Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas.

We’re glad the experience felt positive overall, and your support means a great deal to the team. We’ll keep working to make each visit feel calm, capable, and well cared for.
Everyone including Dr. Himmelberg was great. Very caring, listened & treated my dog professionally & with proper care.

A 5-star visit tells us the team did something right.  

We're glad the experience felt positive at Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas, and we’ll keep aiming for that same steady, reliable care every time.
Luna needed a special vet that understands her wants, needs and fears.  We found it in Cindy and Dr. Hewitt.   Such a calming and reassuring place that appreciates Luna for who she is. Thank you.

A 5-star visit says a lot, and it’s great to see that reflected here. Jess, we’re glad the experience at Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas felt positive from your side. Those steady, reassuring visits are what we aim for every day.

First time experience at Petfolk, and was good overall. Everyone was courteous, and pricing questions were answered directly. Using a $50 promo code when booking online made getting a rabies vaccine for a cat $98. Not the best price, but not the worst. They did a good job! Only 4/5 because the invoice in the email is gated behind an app they want you to download, which is really annoying. I don't want to download your app just to see a basic receipt. Just include it in the email, and have the app as an option :)
They were so nice and friendly to me and my fur baby! They knew exactly what they were doing everything went very smoothly and we will definitely be coming back!!

I had a great experience at Petfolk! The building was very nice and clean, and they even have cat specific rooms with things to keep it a low stress environment. They gave my cat a churu treat, which are her favorite, and she was at ease! The vet tech was very nice, and the vet was knowledgeable and friendly. They both eased my worries about my cat, and the vet even addressed medications that my cat takes for road trips. She gets very nauseous and anxious in the car, and the vet recommended medication that might help her more than what she currently takes. Overall, highly recommended this location!

VERY PLEASED! They saw me at the last minute on a weekend and they were very kind! Both the nurse and dr I saw gave me all the info I needed, complete with an estimate before I consented to the necessary procedures. They gave me the option of pills or an injection and gave me care instructions. Sent me home with a couple pain pills for my baby and told me what to look for before the follow up. Overall, very nice facility with a water dispenser in the lobby.

A 5-star visit means a lot to the team here.

At Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas, we work hard to make care feel steady, attentive, and clear from start to finish. Seeing that reflected in your rating is a strong sign we’re doing the right things.
Amanda and Dr Kim were both super nice and very knowledgeable. Ruger enjoyed meeting them.

Everyone I met while visiting the North Dallas location was extremely nice and gentle with my kitten.  They were extremely informative and answered all my questions about his care and future plans of care. I completely trust them with the care of my kitten and will be going back!

A 5-star rating like this tells us the team delivered the kind of care we aim for every day.

At Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas, consistency and attention to detail matter, and it means a lot to see that reflected here.
Took my great pyrenees mix up there today. The vet and vet tech were very helpful, nice, and informative. Also got a nice discount for our first visit. Definitely recommend.

Extremely friendly staff, everyone was incredibly knowledgeable with the situation I brought my dog in and additional things that I was unaware of that could become problems in the future. Normally my dog get very uncomfortable at vet clinics, but he as happy as could be when he was here. I found my new permanent vet.

Dr. Leah and the whole staff is exceptional! They also were so transparent when it comes to pricing and were able to work with me a lot on payment for my sweet little kittens medical issues, highly recommend

They are very detailed and compassionate with our cat and to me. My cat has IBS and the regime they had me do for him is working.

You also get a detailed email about your visit that day. I am glad I found them!
Angel spent over an an hour patiently and enthusiastically helping my 6 yr old learn everything he needed to know about adopting his first cat. We could not have asked for better care!
Dr Kim is the best for cat veterinary care! She has a conservative approach, understanding aging cats don't respond to textbook care and treatment like dogs.

I have a Petfolk membership which saves me a LOT of money. I can take in my cat to get checked on anytime without having to worry about the exam fee. There's also 24/7 virtual care available. There are a lot of other perks too, but those two things sold me. Most of the time when I go in, my cat is seen by a different veterinarian. However, this hasn't been a problem because each employee is very knowledgeable and obviously cares about my cat. They have been kind to my cat without causing her immense stress. Appointments are also very easy to book and I can often go in same day if I need to. All in all, a very good vet practice in my opinion!

My smiley dog was greeted by a smiling face. We had to come in for a Cytopoint injection. Chelsea was great with my Jeter. Dr. Kim came in for the injection and we were done in about 20 minutes.
Jeter got a little testy because he got backed into the corner and felt threatened.  Next time I will suggest they put him on the table, dispense with the peanut butter distraction and quickly give the shot. I needed to help them get to know my dog. Everyone was very nice, the facility is super clean and modern. It is a convenient location with plenty of parking. Glad to have a new vet clinic in the neighborhood.

EDIT: I stand by the staff being wonderful and taking great care of my pup, but I am taking two stars off for the exorbitant pricing. The dental cleaning pricing on the website says that it is $869 without a membership. If you sign up for the membership, they take $200 off. I understand anesthesia is very expensive, so I went ahead and signed up for the membership ($199 up front) because I figured I would need to save every penny I could for what my pup needed done. When I looked at my itemized estimate that they provided me, it said that the anesthesia and the initial cleaning were going to be $1,103! $2,653 was the final number they gave me, and they said this was on the "low end". If you have that kind of money, I say it's worth it for peace of mind knowing your pup is going to be well cared for, and to be able to deal with kind vets and vet techs. If you don't, don't bother. Teachers like me cannot afford it.

I went to PetFolk for the first time today, with a very nervous senior dog. They made sure the lobby was clear, and they were incredibly kind and patient with both of us while we navigated his issues. I am always a bit worried taking my boy into the vet because he is a very anxious rescue dog, but they made the entire process quick and easy. Price-transparent, no-fear treatments, and experts in their field. I am so happy we found this place!

We absolutely love Petfolk and cannot say enough wonderful things about the exceptional care they have given our entire crew: Bash, Pierce, Riley, Arty, and Lily.

We have Petfolk memberships for all five of our pets, and it has genuinely been one of the best decisions we’ve made for their care. With five furry kiddos, vet expenses can add up incredibly quickly, and the memberships have saved us so much in pet care costs.

The care the Petfolk North Dallas team provided when our 2 year old yellow Lab, Bash, injured his tail especially stands out. After an ER vet recommended amputating his tail, we brought him to Petfolk for another evaluation. Their team took the time to thoroughly assess his injury and explore whether his tail could be saved rather than immediately resorting to such a drastic option. It was an incredibly stressful situation, but they went above and beyond to keep Bash comfortable, closely monitor his healing, and give his tail a chance to recover. Thankfully, it did! We are beyond grateful for the care, patience, and attention they gave him throughout the entire process.

That same level of compassion and attention has been consistent with Pierce, Riley, Arty, and Lily as well. The team takes the time to listen, explain everything clearly, answer our questions, and genuinely treats each of our pets like an individual rather than just another appointment on the schedule.

We’re incredibly grateful to Petfolk for taking such wonderful care of our furry family. Knowing we have a team we trust with all five of our kiddos gives us peace of mind, and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Petfolk, especially to other pet households!

You do not have to buy any medication from the vet office. You can ask for your prescriptions to be filled elsewhere. I learned this after paying $76 for Proviable ($30 on PetSmart) and $52 for 2 tablets Cernia (4 pack on PetSmart for $24). I also learned that veterinary offices do not have to be transparent about the option to shop elsewhere where for medications which is concerning. I originally was happy with the visit but after finding out the drastic price difference I feel scammed. I will not be returning. Transparency is very important and I feel like Petfolk too advantage of me wanting my pet to be well.

Very bad over a series of time until I finally got a good dr. By this time, my dog had been misdiagnosed with the wrong type of cancer. I had paid $700 for x-rays to see if the cancer had spread and blood work which was way overpriced. I feel I was taking advantage of that. My dog wasn’t given the priorities she should’ve had had her surgery earlier. They were backed up and couldn’t take her in. I had to go to another Petfolk, which try to charge me an additional $300 plus another fee. The vet didn’t even see my dog there. There were a series of errors that took place that never should have and it ended up with me having a dog that survived two months after the surgery and suddenly died I’m heartbroken. I’d like my money back. There should’ve been better coordination and they shouldn’t run behind on their surgeries so far to the point where you can’t get a tumor removed. That’s an efficiency that’s a misdiagnosis and in the end it’s a dead dog. I want my money back. It’s wrong. Please contact me.
Everyone there was very professional and very sweet. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone that loves their Fur babies

I left the following 5 stars and comments 10 months ago, and again wanted to leave a 5 star review. Dr. Himmelberg truly went above and beyond for my doggy today. The poor Dr has had to deal with a couple of emergencies from me now and has always been the kindest and most gracious with it. Once again, absolutely recommend them! Dr. Himmelberg is truly the best!!

Nov ‘25- Able to see my pup in short notice and flexible with schedule change. Austin was an extra perk to the appointment, making sure to squeeze time in for my pup and he was very informative and clearly passionate for what he does. Vet and tech also all squeezed in time to take care of us. Great team!

One of my cats was having bloody urine and this was the closest place open on a Saturday. They ran all tests that needed to be done to figure out what was going on. Their after visit summaries are super thorough and helpful. My cat was diagnosed with FLUTD and we have been trying to manage her stress to avoid flare ups through environmental changes as well as medication. None of my cats have ever had to take medicine, so I had a lot of questions to make sure I was doing everything properly.

They provided a number I could text my questions to which has been extremely helpful and easy.  The technicians and vets I have met are so kind and they genuinely care and take interest in your pet. Also, the environment is very calm which I imagine helps anxious pets. I plan on making PetFolk the primary vet for both of my cats.

They also have weekend hours which is super convenient!

They handled my dog with care and compassion. After assessing his situation, we were referred to a veterinary ER where his condition was pinpointed and diagnosed as terminal. I ended up putting my beloved pet to sleep unexpectedly. Had he lived, I believe I would’ve made Petfolk his routine vet since his original had retired earlier in the summer. While my family grieve, I can reflect positively on Petfolk.
The staff was very friendly, professional and prompt. Very impressed! 👍🏼👍🏼

A 5-star visit tells us the experience came together the way it should.  
At Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas, we pay close attention to the details that make an appointment feel smooth and dependable.  
Your rating is a strong sign the team delivered well on that.

It’s wonderful to see a 5-star visit recognized by Bri.  
Experiences like this remind the team why we put such care into every appointment at Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas.  
We’re glad the visit left a strong impression and
Petfolk always make everything better for my pet!!! They are kind, courteous and knowledgeable!!!
Quick visit. Staff and doctor helpful and re-assuring.

A 5-star rating like this tells us the visit landed the right way.  

The team will be glad to know your experience with Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas was a good one, and feedback like this helps confirm the work behind the scenes is paying off.

A 5-star rating like this is always encouraging for the team. It tells us the care, communication, and overall visit came together the way we strive for at Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas.

We appreciate you sharing that positive signal with us.

This place is ridiculous!  Received a text from Katherine, claiming to be a lead with customer service. She accused me of making negative remarks! She should NOT be providing ANY type of service for this company!

Amanda and Dr. H was amazing with my baby. He typically gets anxiety coming to the vet but he did great and they took care of us both and very quick!! I didn’t plan on getting a membership here but it only made sense. I would absolutely recommend them to all my friends and family

It’s great to know your experience with Petfolk Veterinary & Urgent Care - North Dallas was a positive one.

A 5-star visit tells us the team delivered in the right way, and that kind of outcome reflects the standard we aim for every day.

We appreciate you taking a moment to share it.

I love Petfolk. The staff was outstanding and the doctor was fantastic. They never tried to upsell the service. They just did what was needed to make sure our kitty was in good health. Overall it was a very comfortable visit and I would definitely recommend this location on Preston...

The people who work here are all so friendly on arrival and they work to make sure you get what you need done in a range you are looking for. I greatly appreciate this place! The reviews are real, definitely come here!

So, normally I don’t review unless I’ve had an actual experience, but I spoke on the phone with Clarissa and was quoted $99 for a visit and $59 for a nail trim for my 12 year old French Bulldog.  What worries me about this, although I can afford this but very much don’t want to pay these exorbitant costs, are all the people who legitimately can’t afford it and have to scramble to find other alternatives, or worse, put their animals down.  I don’t think this is right.  It’s really too expensive for good honest people to pay these high prices.  I understand why the cost of veterinary medicine has gone up so dramatically in the last few years.  But there’s got to be a middle ground.

So, I saw the response.  I can digest the consultation fee and any diagnostics or surgical fees, which I am certain will be on the high side, for exceptional care.  But $59 for a nail trim is absolutely ridiculous.  There’s no theory under which this makes sense.

Thanks for sharing. We value all feedback and would like the opportunity to address any concerns you may have had. Please reach out to us directly at 833-738-3655 or info@petfolk.com so we can learn more about your experience.
Friendly staff and really care about making sure your heard and all questions answered.

It’s encouraging to know your visit left such a strong impression. We’re glad the care felt attentive and the experience came together smoothly from start to finish. That kind of feedback means a lot to the team, and we’ll keep working to make each visit just as steady and reassuring.

Amazing experience at Petfolk! The staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and quick. After waiting over 4 hours at an emergency clinic for Milo, it was such a relief to arrive at Petfolk and be seen almost immediately. The clinic is very clean, and the veterinarian was fantastic. They listened, asked questions, and explained everything clearly. Milo wasn’t the easiest patient to examine, but the team was patient, kind, and never made a fuss about it. Their pricing is reasonable, they accept CareCredit, and the whole experience was stress-free. Even though it’s a bit of a drive for me, Petfolk has definitely earned my trust and will be Milo’s primary vet going forward. 🐾❤️

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating, Steve! It’s wonderful to know you appreciated our care and attention. Your positive feedback encourages us to continue doing our best. We look forward to seeing you and your pets again soon!
Everyone was amazing with my very anxious dog. I appreciate all they did for me and my Toby. Will definitely be recommending them to my fellow pet owners.
Always professional, kind, and helpful. Love this place!!!

We came to Dallas for the weekend and our German Shepherd was having bad travel anxiety. We walked in to Petfolk and they were able to get our boy in quickly and provided him with the care and needed.

My cat has an issue either an injury or dental related. I was unable to get him in anywhere and was seriously stressing out. Staff worked him in and everyone we interacted with was amazing. Thank you for helping my baby! Im glad we have a new vet home!

Edit to add, I absolutely love the staff, both interacting with my cat and myself..stellar customer service!
This vet office was great at the start, but last two visits I didnt see Vet until 1 hour after scheduled appointment time.

I've now worked with two different vets and I really like both of them. Also Cendy (I think I'm spelling this right) is my favorite teck/nurse! She is so grounded and real! I'm so glad I found this place. My senior kitty is in good, caring hands!

I love PetFolk! I started coming here after getting fed up with the vet I was seeing after adopting my dog. He was a great vet, but the practice was just him and one tech (who also served as the receptionist). Both very sweet and caring people, but the difficulty of getting ahold of them and their weird hours just wasn't sustainable. PetFolk can usually get me in same day or the next day! And their staff is always very pleasant and helpful. One of the vets even has a Great Pyrenees, just like me! It's nice to have a vet who personally understands the breed.

They’re very professional and easy to get ahold of! And they always follow up after appointments to check in on my boy.

Cendy Neave is an amazing vet technician and has been wonderful with my German Shepherd, Hudson. She has such a kind, patient, and caring demeanor that Hudson immediately relaxes when he sees her.

As a pet owner, it's incredibly reassuring to know your dog is being cared for by someone who genuinely loves animals and treats them with compassion. Vet visits can be stressful, especially when your pet isn't feeling well, but Cendy always makes the experience easier and much less stressful.

We're so grateful for her kindness, professionalism, and the exceptional care she provides.

Amazing vet to go to, honestly. We brought in our 3 month old kitten because we noticed he wasn’t himself.. they spoke to us in so much detail and gave us options. The doctor walked back in and stated that she didn’t want to run out pockets dry, but due to her examination, it looked like our kitten wouldn’t have made it even after all the tests. She was so straight up to us and we greatly appreciated it, it’s sad but we did have to put our baby down… but they knew the amount of tests and medications that would’ve been needed definitely wouldn’t have helped him due to how severe it was already. They are so very caring and I would 1,000% trust them with your babies, so very caring and truthful.

Such an amazing team !
They helped me with my cat da Vinci and they gave me Options on what I wanted to do with my cat and they were very informational very knowledgeable and altogether it was just a GREAT experience! They also treated my cat super nicely ! I’ve never seen him cooperate before with other vets .. so overall my cat had a good experience too.

If you visit this clinic, make sure your emergency aligns with their closing schedule. We brought our golden retriever in at 5:50 PM with a worsening hotspot that appeared to be on the verge of infection and wanted to address it before it became a more serious issue.

The clinic was empty, and the veterinarian was visible in the back office. After briefly looking at the issue, the technician informed us they were closing in 10 minutes and “weren’t sure” they could see him. After checking with the veterinarian, we were told she could not examine our dog because she needed to complete callback calls and review lab work before the end of the day.

I understand practices have operating hours and administrative responsibilities. However, it was disappointing to see a pet turned away for a potentially urgent issue while the clinic sat empty during posted business hours. In medicine — whether human or veterinary — there are moments when patient care should outweigh convenience and end-of-day routines.

We always have such a wonderful experience at Petfolk. We went in to spay our French bulldog Coco recently and as nervous flat face dog parents we were nervous but we trusted and knew Coco was in the best hands! We have been going here for about 2.5 years & from the moment we walked in, every staff member made us feel welcomed and cared for. You can tell they truly love what they do.

A special shoutout to Dr. H! Her professionalism, bedside manner, and calm confidence made all the difference for us. She explained everything clearly, treated Coco with so much gentleness, and made me feel completely at ease about the care she was providing. It’s rare to find a vet who combines skill with genuine compassion, but she absolutely does.

I left feeling grateful, reassured, and confident that Coco was in the best hands. Highly recommend Petfolk!

I absolutely could not ask for better care than Adder received today... The whole staff was very emergency oriented... The Doctor was very Knowledgeable with Dogs..and very caring...The vet tech was very good with our Adder, amazing in fact! The building was very quiet and serene. This whole place was definitely a heaven sent for our Adder, and I pray the whole staff is blessed because they have blessed us with another day with our Pet!!!
Thank you so much for caring the way that you do!!!
Taylor~
Excellent service

Dexter had a great visit at the Petfolk in Dallas. I appreciate every thing about Petfolk, they scheduled a last minute emergency appt for Dexter. The clinic is very nice, clean and the staff are so friendly. We plan to continue taking Dexter there in the future and will choose them for our other pets for regular checkups etc. Highly recommend.

They are a very nice vet! I was a little anxious bringing my baby girl in but they were quick to make me and my girl Nala feel comfortable and attended too. They only want the best for our companions 💗💗
always such a great experience here, do truly appreciate the staff and the vet always being so kind and informative
The staff were so kind, helpful, and patient with my pet. The rooms are designed with pets in mind and the whole experience felt warm and welcoming. Highly recommend ^^

We're grateful for your 5-star rating! It's heartening to know you value our service. Your support motivates us to keep providing the best care possible. We can't wait to welcome you and your pets back!
The best veterinarian in the nation is incredibly loving and caring.
Simply great and dedicated service

Our dog suffered several stings and started swelling pretty bad. We took her here and the tech Manda was so wonderful and quick. Got us registered and had the vet seeing us in about 8 mins! It was so great. The vet on staff was awesome and gave her the meds she needed super quickly so the pain didn’t linger. Thank you so much!
First time visit today, they handled my nervous dog very nicely, he's not too open to new ppl but they were very nice, paciente and informative.
They did a great job examining and caring for my cat when my regular vet was all booked! I can definitely see myself coming back! :)

We had our first visit today after transferring from another popular pet franchise.  We were greeted with hospitality upon entry and taken to a room immediately.  The tech and the provider were wonderful and took their time to get to know our puppy and love on her before any care was rendered.  We loved that the provider sat down and took her time to talk to us, addressed all of our questions (I had many) and did that with compassion and care.  If you've had mediocre care from other pet franchises, definitely consider giving Petfolk the chance to earn your business.  The annual care package is worth it-great discounts!
We're so happy to know you enjoyed your experience with us, Alan! Our team is always here to make sure your visits are positive. We look forward to seeing you and your furry friend again soon!
Tried them today for the 1st time urgent care and will NEVER go to another vet again!!! Elizabeth and Dr. Bobo are extremely awesome!!!! Best Vet Ever!!!!! Thanks for helping Bentley!!!!!

We had a great experience at Petfolk and felt like we were in kind hands. I took my pup for his annual check up and a few needed vaccines. It was our first time here and all went smoothly. Both the nurse and the doctor were very thorough and they did everything in the room with me which I think helped my anxious pup! I’d def recommend them if you’re looking for a new vet!
The Dr. was very informative and was gentle with our family pet. Communicated well to my daughter about her sweet puppy’s needs. My dog liked him.
Manda was amazing and I’m happy I went today. They treated my Rarri girl with so much love and care and can’t wait to be back. <3

Definitely recommend very friendly fast so thankful
My baby girl is in good hands she a Pitbull and was treated on the spot very affordable you can use your afterpay
Great experience at Petfolk. The team was professional and welcoming. Chelsea was especially kind and helpful, and she made sure my dog felt comfortable during the visit.

I was disappointed in my visit today with the vet. Everything was going well until Dr. Brianna Wiest came into the room. The nurses before her were able to calmly and successfully draw blood from my kitten, but when Dr. Wiest tried to give her an injection, she had no bedside manners when talking to me and treating my kitten. My kitten was distressed and reacted poorly to the doctor because she did not know how to approach my kitten to calm her down. Additionally, Dr. Wiest made me feel inadequate as a pet owner and like she was scolding us because of my kitten’s behavior. The people that came in before the Doctor were super professional and patient in treating my kitten, but the doctor was not. It felt like the appointment took a complete 180 when the doctor came in. She should have try to be more patient and courteous with the pet owners. My previous experience with Petfolk was great, so I was truly disappointed with this visit.
Friendly staff very informative and exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend!!
We really love the staff and their treatment of our pup! So glad they moved to the neighborhood
Hello Raymond! Thank you so much for giving us a 5-star rating. We truly value your trust in our dedicated care for your fur family. Can't wait to help you again soon!

I can always trust a great experience for Guava at the Petfolk Preston clinic. She is always comfortable there, no hesitation or anxiety just a lot of excitement. Super valuable membership, EXCELLENT care team, very convenient and on time appointments- Highly recommend!

Hello! We’re so happy to see your 5-star rating! It brings us joy to know that we've made a positive impact during your visit. We're excited to continue providing top-notch care for your furry friends!

I just so happened to stumble upon Petfolk by chance due to an urgent need for my dog Benji. And WOW. So glad I did!!

The care everyone took to ensure my worries were addressed were amazing. Not only did they take care of Benji but they included me in the options for his care which I appreciated. Even when I retuned with concerns they were quickly taken care of.

I did end up signing up for the annual membership for $199 and the 24/7 access to a nurse is amazing. One of the nurses has been checking in periodically on his progress, which I’ve never had done before so I must say it feels so reassuring.

Definitely 10/10 experience so far!

The staff was so kind, they move well between rooms so we still felt like our puppy was treated with urgency and care although no life threatening issues. We didn’t feel pressured, trapped, or marketed at, and lastly the pricing was so fair and reasonable I wouldn’t ever go anywhere else again after just one visit.

I can't overstate how excellent this place is, but the biggest highlight are the people working there. The amount of attention and care they gave my cat Willow today was exceptional; they were always checking on her, gave her insulin steadily throughout the day, and even got her to purr during the initial exam despite her fears. All this while I was being, frankly, hysterical. After today's experience, I am absolutely going to continue taking Willow and any future pets here. 10/5

EDIT: Somehow I forgot to mention - the doctor independently found me the cheapest/best treatment I could get while this clinic was closed. They gave me a much lower estimate than anything else I could find, and it ended up being even lower. I am super grateful for their help and support during this

We're so grateful for your 5-star rating! It’s fantastic to know you had a positive experience with us. At Petfolk, everyone is passionate about providing excellent veterinary care. We're looking forward to seeing you and your furry friend again!

Brought our two month old in for kennel cough, gave a prescription that did not help with anything which is okay. Moved on to a different medication in which the vet changed answers on if we could take it with the previous medication or not. Now our dog is in severe pain from the medication in which we will have to bring him in AGAIN! Not only did the problem get worse, nothing has been solved and very upset that it was handled this way.

I first visited Petco December 7th. Sadie my cat is 20 years old she has kidney disease and some arthritis and the vet that I went to a year ago VCA did absolutely nothing after all the tests they ran. Petco however ran the tests and actually gave me some things to do that actually have made her better. I couldn't ask for any better veterinarian but I would definitely not recommend the VCA these guys at Petco are great!

We're truly grateful for the stellar 5-star rating, and are overjoyed to know that our service met your expectations! 😊 It's heartwarming to have your support, and we can't wait to see both you and your furry friend again soon! …

Thank you so much for giving us a glowing rating! We're delighted that you're happy with your experience at our clinic. Your support means a lot to us and we're looking forward to welcoming you and your pet back anytime.
Such a great experience at our visit tonight! The facility is gorgeous, clean, the staff is kind and put us at ease. Prices are very fair. I truly couldn’t recommend them enough!

Petfolk is so cute and clean! Everyone is very friendly and will love on your fur baby. The doctor was very kind, patient and informative! It was our puppies first vet visit and they made her feel very comfortable and safe. We would highly recommend!

Our senior Cairn Terrier had a much needed dental cleaning, 8 extractions and an abscessed back molar, which they gave her an antibiotic.
Very nice staff. We were presently surprised at the low bill!
Always friendly and thoughtful towards our dog. Answered all the questions I had and quick and easy to make an appointment and check I .

This was my first time here and it was an okay first visit as a first time kitten/ cat owner. The business is nice and clean, and the staff are friendly and provided good care with my two kittens! However when I went to book, I booked through their app and directly listed rabies and FCVRP as the 2 services I would be needing today. Upon arrival and check in, the assistant welcomed me and did a short wellness check for both kittens: including taking their temp, weight, and listening to their heartbeat. I initially thought this was standard practice at first as this is my first time with a pet and visiting the vet etc. However upon receiving the electronic quote and confirmation to approve services, I saw a fee of I believe $90-100 per kitten for that short wellness exam. Which I didn’t anticipate, and would’ve opted out to pay for if I was given notice. However this was after the quick exam was already done (took around 1 minute for each kitten). Additionally, during small talk (after the wellness check) while waiting on the main doctor to come and administer the shots, I asked some general questions about general kitten care and upkeep and what I should expect and what they’d recommend to do from now until they are around 1 year (adult). The assistant was knowledgeable, answered my questions and gave good details about the services she recommended and that they offer there for kittens. However , when came time to receive the quote to approve work, the bill was close to $800 , which included a majority of the services that had just been discussed. The only reason I am iffy is that I never stated during the conversation that I wanted to do any of them today/ confirmed to them, and I also thought it was clearly stated through the booking what I was there for service wise. After I brought this to their attention and was confused, they kindly took the unrelated services off. Ultimately I was anticipating around a $100-200 bill for the shots for both kittens and ended up paying around $350 due to the wellness exam charge for both kittens. I’m just kind of confused on how 2-3 minutes of a basic quick check of the kittens can be ~2/3 of the final bill, especially when the wellness exam wasn’t as thorough as I anticipated.
